description: Files that reach a model provider outside the governed AI gateway — by constructing an SDK client, calling a provider endpoint directly, or using a shared client factory's returned client. This is the gateway-bypass burndown list. Do NOT add to it: route new AI calls through server/services/ai-gateway (getGateway) or server/lib/unified-ai-client. Every entry carries a REASON stating what governance is lost; an entry without one fails the gate. Removing entries by routing them through the gateway is the point. Enforced by scripts/ci/check-gateway-bypass.mjs.

server/services/anthropic-client.ts.reason: Shared Anthropic client factory — the canonical place a raw client is constructed for callers that have not yet moved to the gateway. Kept as burndown, not blessed: baselining the CONSTRUCTOR is what let ungoverned CALLS through getAnthropicClient() spread to files nobody baselined, which is why this gate now matches the call sites too.

server/services/openai-client.ts.reason: Shared OpenAI client factory — same status and same caveat as anthropic-client.ts above.

server/services/ai/LiteLLMAdapter.ts.reason: WIDEST BYPASS. Posts to `${this.baseUrl}/chat/completions` — an OpenAI-compatible proxy — and server/services/aiProviderRouter.ts makes the gateway the ELSE branch: `if (this.liteLLMAdapter.isEnabled()) { ... } else { executeViaGateway(...) }`. One env flag (LITELLM_ENABLED) therefore diverts EVERY routed call away from policy evaluation, the PII/PHI fail-closed screen, the provider-placement/residency check and the ai.gateway_audit_log row; the router writes its own ai_provider_audit_log row with no prompt hash, resolved model or residency. .env.example defaults it false and nothing in helm/terraform/compose sets it, so this is latent rather than live — and nothing announces at boot that the gateway has been bypassed.

server/api/ai/routes.ts.reason: POST /api/ai/regulatory-guidance fetches https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions directly with model 'gpt-4o' and temperature 0.7. 'gpt-4o' is a floating alias and nothing records which model actually answered; no prompt hash over a system prompt that interpolates caller context; no fallback chain, so one non-200 becomes a 503. Mounted at /api/ai.

server/routes/graphrag.ts.reason: extractEntities() fetches https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions (gpt-4o-mini) with up to 8000 characters of ingested regulatory document text, from POST /api/graphrag/query and /ingest. Same missing audit as api/ai/routes.ts, plus the PII/PHI classifier never sees the ingested body, and a failure silently degrades to regex extraction with no provenance distinction between model-extracted and regex-extracted entities.

server/services/deep-research-orchestrat.reason: generateSynthesis() calls getAnthropicClient().messages.create(...) for a 4096-token regulatory-intelligence briefing that is persisted and shown to users. Invisible to the old guard because the CONSTRUCTION lives in the baselined anthropic-client.ts and the call site was never scanned. No audit row, no prompt hash over the aggregated evidence corpus, no retry ladder — a failure silently swaps in buildFallbackSynthesis().

server/services/EvidenceManagementServic.reason: Sends 4000 characters of an UPLOADED customer evidence file to gpt-4o via getOpenAIClient().chat.completions.create. Same shared-client blind spot as deep-research-orchestrator. No PII/PHI classification and no substrate/retention record on customer file content. Reachable from /api/evidence-management and from authoring-actions.

server/huggingface-service.ts.reason: generateEmbeddings() and queryHuggingFace() axios.post to api-inference.huggingface.co (Mixtral, Llama-2, Zephyr). A whole second provider with its own HF_API_KEY, absent from the gateway's provider model, cost accounting, residency model and audit ledger. generateEmbeddings additionally bypasses embedding-corpus-policy.ts and its dimension-consistency guarantee. Five other methods in this file were already migrated to aiComplete; these two were not.

server/services/nanoBananaService.ts.reason: new GoogleGenerativeAI(GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY); /generate and /edit are image generation, but the /chat and presentation paths are multi-turn text inference on gemini-2.0-flash. It also relaxes Google's harm thresholds to BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH with no compensating gateway policy pass. Mounted at /api/nano-banana.

server/services/rag-reranker.ts.reason: Cross-encoder rerankers at api.cohere.com/v2/rerank and api.voyageai.com/v1/rerank, shipping the user query plus up to 2000 characters of each retrieved document. Active only when RAG_RERANKER_PROVIDER + _API_KEY + _MODEL are all set, so latent by default; when active there is no audit row, no PII screen on retrieved corpus content, and tokensUsed is reported as 0 unconditionally so cost is structurally invisible.

server/services/anthropic-files.ts.reason: Anthropic Files API upload/delete, not inference. It is still content egress to a model provider that the gateway's PII/PHI screen never sees, and the uploaded file is later referenced by gateway-routed calls. Feature-flagged off by default. Recorded as a bypass of the content-screening layer rather than of model-call audit.

server/routes/integration-test.ts.reason: NOT INFERENCE. Fetches https://api.openai.com/v1/models purely as a reachability probe (the code says so: 'don't burn tokens'), and the router is mounted only under testRoutesEnabled, so it is fenced out of production. Baselined rather than path-excluded because it IS egress to a provider host and should stay visible if that mount fence ever moves.

server/services/submission-twin-service..reason: Constructs `const openai = getOpenAIClient()` at module load and never uses it. Dead construction — the fix is deletion, not migration.

server/services/innovation/auto-traceabi.reason: openai.embeddings.create via the shared client — allowlisted by the embedding-runtime canonicality gate, outside the AI gateway's audit trail.

server/services/innovation/regulatory-de.reason: openai.embeddings.create via the shared client — allowlisted by the embedding-runtime canonicality gate, outside the AI gateway's audit trail.

server/services/innovation/regulatory-ne.reason: openai.embeddings.create via the shared client — allowlisted by the embedding-runtime canonicality gate, outside the AI gateway's audit trail.

server/services/semanticSearch.js.reason: DEAD CODE. axios.post to api.openai.com/v1/embeddings, but its only importers (server/pipelines/bulk_import.js, indexDocs.js) are themselves recorded as unreferenced modules, and its DB target is a logged no-op since the Phase 2 retrieval convergence. Kept visible because it is still on the embedding-runtime APPROVED list; deleting the file resolves both.

server/services/huggingface-service.js.reason: DEAD CODE. axios.post to api-inference.huggingface.co (Llama-2-70b). Zero importers; recorded in unreferenced-modules-baseline.json. Superseded by the .ts service of the same name.

server/services/csr-extractor-service.ts.reason: DEAD CODE. getOpenAIClient().chat.completions.create with gpt-4-turbo-preview, reachable only through a barrel chain (services/csr/index.ts ← services/index.ts) that is itself recorded as unreferenced; the exported csrExtractorService symbol has zero call sites.
